automations.name: codex-home-health-report

scope.write_boundary: report only; do not modify source, build, live or remote systems

automations.stop_condition: stop after report generation or after two consecutive health-check failures

run_lifecycle.first_run: manual review of health summary before any recurring use
run_lifecycle.steady_state: produce a dated report and stop without modifying source, build, live or remote systems
run_lifecycle.stale_after: one business day or two consecutive health-check failures
cleanup: discard transient command logs after summary
keep only action queue and verification command list
run_lifecycle.retention: retain report summary only when user asks to archive it

automations.name: external-feedback-triage

scope.write_boundary: draft only; never send, submit, merge, delete or publish

automations.stop_condition: stop when authorization expires, source access changes or the thread is handed off

run_lifecycle.first_run: manual review of approved data sources and draft-only boundary
run_lifecycle.steady_state: refresh approved summaries, draft responses and stop at human approval gates
run_lifecycle.stale_after: authorization expiry, source access change or 30 minutes without new signal
cleanup: remove stale draft replies after handoff
keep unresolved questions in the action queue
run_lifecycle.retention: retain only sanitized action queue or archived research note

automations.name: official-docs-watch

scope.write_boundary: research note only; no config, manifest or memory writes without a separate task

automations.stop_condition: stop after producing a dated change note or when official sources cannot be verified

run_lifecycle.first_run: manual review of official source scope and citation requirements
run_lifecycle.steady_state: check official sources, produce a dated note and route reusable items to review
run_lifecycle.stale_after: one week or when official sources cannot be verified
cleanup: do not keep raw page dumps
route reusable conclusions to archive or memory candidate review
run_lifecycle.retention: retain dated note only when source links and retrieval date are present
